title: DIOR-SKEIN
summary: A research report repository on heterogeneous data analytics for radio access networks, which vendors an entire copy of the CTGAN-master source tree in-tree. The vendored CTGAN package's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (which internally rely on rdt transformers) constitute the SDV-family code, though no evidence shows it being invoked outside the bundled README example.
evidence: CTGAN-master/ directory is a full vendored copy of sdv-dev/CTGAN, incl. ctgan/synthesizers/ctgan.py and tvae.py
needs: Unclear whether the vendored CTGAN bundle is actually invoked by the DIOR-SKEIN project code or only carried as an unused dependency copy
